about: Log 411 re-score set, written 2026-10-12 before any run of it. Gold verdicts follow scripts/capability_sheet.yaml (closed world on produces; with_step results are supported). Families as heldout15 (FREEZE408): PL, PS, PI, PQ supported; NM near misses; NF far from any network method; NV result kinds no earlier held-out set asked for and the sheet does not list (also MX6's second requirement, marked novel); MX one supported and one unsupported result; K a second turn that adds only a condition (KN unsupported, KP supported; --resume).
